WHAT IS INCLUDED IN OUR LOCAL SEO SERVICE

Local SEO puts your business at the top of Google Maps and local search results for the searches that matter most — the ones with buying intent from people in your area. We handle everything from Google Business Profile optimisation to hyper-local content.
Retainers from €1,500 a month. Every engagement starts with a free audit, so you see the plan before you pay for anything.
Google Business Profile
Complete optimisation of your GBP listing — categories, attributes, posts, and Q&A.
Review Management
Strategy and tools for generating more positive reviews and managing your reputation.
Local Citations
Consistent NAP (Name, Address, Phone) citations across 50+ local directories.
Local Content
Location-specific pages and blog content targeting your service area.
Local Link Building
Links from local news, directories, and community websites.
Local Rank Tracking
Grid-based rank tracking across your service area, not just a single postcode.

QUESTIONS PEOPLE ASK BEFORE HIRING US FOR LOCAL SEO
Answers written and reviewed by Khalid Farhan, founder. Last reviewed November 2026.
How much does Local SEO cost in Kilkenny?
Retainers from €1,500 a month. The exact figure depends on the size of the opportunity and the amount of work, so we do a free audit first and quote from that. There is no charge for the audit.
Do you work with businesses in Kilkenny?
Yes. We work with businesses in Kilkenny and across Ireland. Most of the work is done remotely with regular calls and a monthly report; Dublin-based clients can meet us in person.
Do I need local SEO if I already have a website?

Yes. A website alone doesn't guarantee Google Maps visibility. Local SEO ensures you appear in the map pack and local organic results — which often get more clicks than the regular results for local searches.
How long does local SEO take?
Most clients see improvements in Google Maps rankings within 4–8 weeks of GBP optimisation. More competitive markets take longer.
Do you work with businesses outside Ireland?
Yes. We deliver local SEO for businesses in the UK, Bangladesh, and globally.
Can you manage multiple locations?
Yes. We have multi-location programmes for businesses with 2–100+ locations.
